column1: # Test 8 grades (agent with a sealed browser; same rubric as tests 5/6), from the private bake-off grades.

column14: Vision off; 42 browser calls, 6 compactions, 90 min. Five cream and red storeys with raised eave blocks, stepped gold spire, stone platform, three cherry trees, pond with footbridge, red torii; orbit by code, petals, shadows.

Vision off; 30 browser calls, 4 screenshots, 2 compactions, 19 min. Everything draws; the eave tips are detached stepped blocks that float apart from the roofs (A 1). Four cherry trees, pond, torii, lantern.

Vision off; 14 browser calls, 1 compaction, 11 min. Five storeys with raised double eave blocks, stepped gold spire, three trees, round pond, large torii. Title glyphs show as boxes (no CJK font in the renderer; not scored).
Vision off; 32 browser calls, 1 compaction, 114 min. Clean render, ringed red and gold spire; the eave upturns are single cubes level with the upper layer, so none visibly rises (C 1).

Vision off; 48 browser calls, 5 screenshots, 33 min. The camera sits too close: only storeys 2 to 4 are in frame, so the top storey and spire never show (C 1); the pond is buried under the platform (D 1).
Vision off; 25 browser calls, 1 screenshot, 1 compaction, 11 min. Dark sky and fog with the camera so close that blossom cubes block the view; no recognisable pagoda, the spire never shows (C 0).

Vision on; 75 browser calls, 6 screenshots, 52 min. The ground is a plane and the sky a sphere (B 1); the spire is a very long pole that runs out of frame (C 1); two cherry trees, one standing in the pond.
Vision off; 11 browser calls, 26 min. The camera aspect is never updated, so the scene is stretched 1.6 times sideways (A 1); the spire is cut off at the top (C 1); the pond is out of frame (D 1).
Vision off; 21 browser calls, 1 screenshot, 51 min. Wall cubes overlap the wood ring and z-fight (A 1); the camera cuts the spire off (C 1); platform, four cherry trees, pond and torii all visible.
Vision off; 27 browser calls, 2 screenshots, 63 min. Clean render; the gold spire runs out of the top of the frame (C 1); platform, five cherry trees, round pond, torii, two lanterns.

Vision off; 35 browser calls, 2 screenshots, 11 min. Every tree trunk is placed near the origin, so the canopies float and stubs poke out of the pagoda (A 1, D 1); the ground is a plane (B 1); no petal is ever visible (E 1).

Vision off (the entry has no vision path); 54 browser calls, 0 screenshots, 0 compactions, 16 min. All frames render a complete scene; most parts are cubes but the roofs use half-height slabs (B 1); five storeys with upturned eaves and spire, stone platform, cherry trees, pond, torii; camera moves and petals fall.
